svg.title: COCO polygon rasterization: inclusive fill versus reference fill
svg.desc: Animation of one square COCO polygon with vertices at (1.65, 1.65) and (5.65, 5.65) on an 8 by 8 pixel grid. The supervision rasterizer rounds the vertices to 2 and 6 and fills inclusively, giving 25 pixels. The pycocotools rasterizer keeps continuous vertices and fills pixels whose centre is inside the boundary, giving 16 pixels. The final frame shows the 9 extra pixels and an IoU of 0.64.
svg.text: continuous coordinates (px); each pixel is one grid cell
